# **Blue Keycard - Game Access Pack**
**How to:**
To be able to produce this access keycard, you need to own an "AIGOD Major Assembly Hub"
https://neftyblocks.com/assets/1099935709108

Mint exclusive access keys, and sell them to players on the secondary market.
Try to reach harmony between profit, and affordabillity, the other factory owners will do he same ;-)
Market your keys, or sell them directly for boosted results.

All blend earnings go directly to the player rewards pool.
(100% minus standard transaction fees & burn)

Leren more. Visit the AIGOD Telegram: https://aigodtoken.com/telegram/

![](https://ipfs.neftyblocks.io/ipfs/QmahqfcWTVjZihHhnyw41uLKZN96JwyqspLM9Nb4nCHKMW)

**About the item you forge with this action:**

Open this pack to get an NFT that grants you access to the Flip Tribes game. 
Packs also often offer a random chance for better, or additional items.

**Details:**

**SLOT 1: 100% chance for: ** Blue Keycard (Grants game access + works as Power-Up)

**SLOT 2: 25% chance for: **  chance for: Golden Ticket (spin the wheel of fortune)

Unpack here: https://neftyblocks.com/collection/fliptribes/packs/atomicpacksx/11542

Leran more about Flip Tribes: https://fliptribes.com/
